static_traits.name: 李拉
static_traits.family_status: Has a sister who plays guitar
static_traits.social_status: 与同事的关系因自责而有所紧张；Has supportive family resources（姐妹），但尚not yet主动求助
static_traits.medical_history: not yet有类似心理问题史；without既往心理治疗；without明显身体疾病

basic_info.main_problem: 因为一位Student的英语文学考试not及格，我觉得自己是个without用的老师，出现without能感与自责。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些without能感影响了我的自尊和有效教学能力，因此寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于Student的成绩

special_situations.event: 该Student的英语文学考试not及格
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果Student考试失败，就说明我是without能且not称职的老师
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立即Reflection并negate自己的教学方法，寻求同事反馈并计划更换教学策略
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这It is all my fault，我是个without用的老师

special_situations.event: 考试成绩发布后看到not及格结果
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次失败就能证明我整体教学能力not足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling work, trying more one-on-one tutoring to make up for the 'failure'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一名Studentnot及格就说明我not称职

special_situations.event: 在教学中遇到Student表现not佳或成绩下滑
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果任何Student表现not好，就代表我作为老师的价值归零
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces leisure and relaxation; puts all energy into improving teaching
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough/我失败了

special_situations.event: 同时存在成功Student的积极反馈与一位Student失败的情况
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有所有Student都表现Good才能证明我合格，个do not成功not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly focuses on failure cases and ignores positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些成功not重要，我仍然是个without用的老师

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可为称职且有价值的Teacher，Student能在我的指导下取得进步
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为without能、被责备或失去他人的尊重与职业价值
defense_goal: By over-taking responsibility and self-criticism, maintains a sense of control and avoids others' criticism

object_relations.self_representation: 因为Student失败而自责、担心自己是without能的老师
object_relations.object_representation: Student的成绩与他人评价被体验为对自己能力的严厉评判者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当讨论或面对Student考试失败与成绩反馈时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人会把失败归咎于自己，自己必须为Student的成绩负全责
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以低沉、自责的语气表述，反复强调“It is all my fault”，减少对外部因素的探讨，主动承担责任。

manifestations: 在Studentnot及格后感到“所有努力都毫Meaninglessness”
认为自己的教学投入被失败结果negate
outcomes: Difficulty enjoying knitting and other leisure activities

manifestations: 虽有支持的姐妹但迟迟not yet向其倾诉
Tense relationships with colleagues due to self-blame

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将“Student成绩好坏=老师好坏”视为必须遵循的标准
自述“我应该为Student的成绩负责”

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动，或放弃向外寻求do not人为其做某事，转而对自己做，将原欲对外发出的能量Turning against the self，与“冲动”对应。
manifestations: have not向支持性的姐妹求助，转而自责
Copes with feelings of failure by reducing leisure and self-punishment

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection abilities, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively harsh on himself; repeatedly examines his own teaching methods
Still strongly doubts self when colleagues give positive feedback

positive_force: 有成功Student并给予积极反馈
Colleagues offering positive evaluations and support
愿意Reflection并尝试新教学方法（如一对一辅导、调整材料）
Has a supportive sister who can provide emotional support
negative_force: 过度个人化Student成绩为自身过错
过度概括一次失败为整体without能
Mental filtering: ignores positive evidence and success cases
Self-denial导致Tense relationships with colleagues并减少休闲

target_behavior.behavior: 在Student表现not佳或考试失败后出现强烈自责与“I am useless老师”的Self-denial思维
antecedent: Receiving exam scores or negative feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值与Student成绩强绑定，存在过度概括与个人化的认知扭曲
target_behavior.function: 维持控制感并试图通过自责促使自身改变，避免面对not确定性与外部因素
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance、Tense relationships with colleagues、Low mood、Impaired self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: 难以放松、减少或without法享受编织等休闲活动
target_behavior.core_reason: 自我惩罚与内疚驱动的Retroflection倾向
target_behavior.function: Restricting self-enjoyment to 'make up for mistakes' and relieve guilt
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased quality of life、恢复力降低、压力积累
